reviewItem.question: Does "Provider v1beta3 schema: allowed values changed: `spec.type`" mean a change to crd-field:flux|group=notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io|version=v1beta3|kind=Provider|path=spec.type (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: In the notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta3 schema of providers.notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io, the allowed values of spec.type changed between flux v2.6.4 and v2.7.0: the values "otel" and "zulip" were added and no previously allowed value was removed, so nothing that validated before is rejected.
